name: @gymmap/config
description: One configuration source for every workspace — tsconfig presets, and from M-002 the ESLint, Prettier, Jest, dependency-cruiser, commitlint, Playwright and size-limit configs.
//: M-001 · §3.6 script contract. A no-op is the literal string, never a missing script — a missing script makes `turbo run` succeed by omission, which is indistinguishable from passing.
//tailwind: DesignSystem.md §2.4 and FolderStructure.md §14 put the Tailwind preset re-export HERE, so apps import one thing. That makes config depend on ui, so ui must NOT depend on config — turbo rejects the cycle outright. packages/ui/tsconfig.json therefore extends the preset by relative path, with the reason recorded there.
